programme.title: I was a king - Lucjan Brychczy
programme.desc: A series presenting the profiles of the best scorers in the history of the Premier League. This is a great opportunity to recall the successes of Włodzimierz Lubański, Grzegorz Lata, Kazimierz Kmiecik, Grzegorz Piechna and Tomasz Frankowski. We will get to know different football generations. In the 1960s, Włodzimierz Lubański (Górnik Zabrze) was the top scorer four times in a row. However, in the 1970s, Kazimierz Kmiecik (Wisła Kraków) and Grzegorz Lato (Stal Mielec) reigned supreme. In more modern times, Tomasz Frankowski won four titles in the colors of Wisła Kraków and Jagiellonia Białystok. There will also be the story of Grzegorz Piechna, the unexpected top scorer from Korona Kielce in 2006. Lucjan Brychczy is a true legend of Legia Warsaw. He was a man deeply experienced in life. For a child harmed by the war, football was a way to survive in difficult times. He was associated with the capital club from 1954 until his death in 2024. Poland. 2022-2025. documentary series

Atlético de Madrid acquired the most desired player of the moment: Paulo Futre, recent European champion with Porto. A relationship then begins between club and player, whom the passage of time has made inseparable. Decades later, the memory of his football passes from generation to generation and turns Futre into the flag and shield of an entire fan base.

The Brazilian, along with some former teammates and friends, reviews the career of what many consider to be the best player in history in his area.

programme.desc: «90 years of LaLiga (2019): Paco Gento» Francisco Gento López, better known as Paco Gento, is living history of Real Madrid and European and world football. He holds the record of being the player who has won the most European Cups, six, and has the most League Championship titles, twelve. He arrived at the white club when he was 18 years old and after 18 consecutive seasons he closed the most brilliant and still valid record in the history of LaLiga. His younger brothers Julio and Antonio also played in the First Division and over time, another family generation emerged, the Llorente-Gento dedicated to the world of sports. José Luis and Toñín, the two oldest, became very visible in the world of basketball while Paco and Julio Llorente opted for football. A fourth generation of athletes in the Llorente-Gento family keeps the flame alive with Marcos Llorente, current Real Madrid first team player

programme.desc: «Football according to Raúl (1): The whitest Cup» On June 4, 1980, we experienced a historic match in Spanish football, because it had never been played and will never be played again. That night the Real Madrid players and the eleven of their subsidiary took to the pitch at the Santiago Bernabéu to play in the final of the Copa del Rey. 40 years later Raúl intends to tell us that story of Castilla matagigantes and what happened to the players who lived that special night

programme.desc: «Robinson Report (7): The passion according to Chimy Ávila» When Ezequiel Ávila walked through the door of his house in a precarious neighborhood of Rosario, Argentina, he came across a soccer field. Growing up in that pasture in a forgotten corner, the boy nicknamed Chimy, the fifth of nine siblings, has become accustomed to overcoming extreme situations: economic shortages, complaints, years without playing, the serious illness of a newborn daughter and, now, a serious injury at the best moment of his career. But the Osasuna player has overcome any obstacle clinging to his passion for football and his religious convictions.

programme.title: 30 for 30: Once Upon a Time in Queens, Part 1
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.desc: 2015 г. Год: 2015. Страна: Kanada. Год: 2015. S1, Ep10 «City Wildlife Rescue»…Look in on a mama rabbit who's caring for an adopted baby, as the staff assesses the little bunny's safety. Can this odd couple stay together? Then meet a hearing-impaired bat and see how the release team is helping him get back homeThis 12 part documentary series will show which animals actually live in the city, and what kind of trouble they encounter. When they do need help a rescue team is dispatched. Once rescued the animals are brought to this humble, but efficient, facility where a full time veterinarian is on hand. Problems are assessed, plans are put into action. programme.title: Life's Journey: Life's Legacies (S1E3). Documentary about nature. Canada, 2017. S1, Ep3
programme.desc: 2017 г. Год: 2017. Страна: Kanada. Год: 2017. S1, Ep3 «Life's Journey»…For every species on earth the right to mate is the purpose of life. Passing on your genes to the next generation is every animal's legacy. But it's not easy, it can be a struggle to find a mate and then a fight to gain access. Only the strongest and most determined will win at Luangwa's mating gameWith stunning fotage from the wilds of Africa, this three-part documentary series examines how the indigenous creatures of this fascinating continent deal with risk and danger when thay are at their most vulnerable and susceptible to attack. The show begins with how the parents of newborn animals defend them against the unwelcome attentions of predators when their young are expereincing the frightening realities of life for the very first time. As the offspring grow older, their place in the world is still uncertain with many obstacles to overcome before they reach the relative safety of adulthood. The final epsiode looks at the crucial mating rituals which ensure the survival of the speciesDirector: Gérald Calderon, Hannah HoareCast: Gillian Burke

programme.title: Life's Journey: Life's Legacies (S1E3). Documentary about nature. Canada, 2017. S1, Ep3
programme.desc: 2017 г. Год: 2017. Страна: Kanada. Год: 2017. S1, Ep3 «Life's Journey»…For every species on earth the right to mate is the purpose of life. Passing on your genes to the next generation is every animal's legacy. But it's not easy, it can be a struggle to find a mate and then a fight to gain access. Only the strongest and most determined will win at Luangwa's mating gameWith stunning fotage from the wilds of Africa, this three-part documentary series examines how the indigenous creatures of this fascinating continent deal with risk and danger when thay are at their most vulnerable and susceptible to attack. The show begins with how the parents of newborn animals defend them against the unwelcome attentions of predators when their young are expereincing the frightening realities of life for the very first time. As the offspring grow older, their place in the world is still uncertain with many obstacles to overcome before they reach the relative safety of adulthood. The final epsiode looks at the crucial mating rituals which ensure the survival of the speciesDirector: Gérald Calderon, Hannah HoareCast: Gillian Burke

programme.title: d/s Zog and the heavenly rivers (Drought)
programme.desc: In the heart of the Pantanal in western Brazil - the largest wetland region in the world - lies the kingdom of Zoga, the leader of a troop of howler monkeys. During the rainy season, his house turns into an island. Zog and his relatives have always lived in a rhythm determined by nature. But one day it is broken, and the forest inhabitants face a grueling and long wait for rain. The disappearance of water took everyone by surprise: birds, caimans, monkeys and the real owner of these places - the anaconda Olima. For the first time, the heavenly rivers put Zog's kingdom in danger of extinction. France

programme.title: d/s Zog and the Heavenly Rivers (Time of Water)
programme.desc: The rains were already 40 days late. It was getting hotter day by day. It seemed like it would never rain again. Zog began to consider the sun his enemy, he lost all hope, and his condition began to worry his relatives. The forest was dying without water. For the first time, Zog thought that the end had come for all the inhabitants of the forest crowns. Predators became active and the monkeys' lives were in danger. But finally, the heavenly rivers returned, and life in the rainforest was reborn again. France

programme.title: d/f Little Fox

programme.title: d/f Wild Australia
programme.desc: Australia is not only a continent with a unique nature, but also home to many rare and amazing species of flora and fauna. The project explores ecosystems, amazing natural phenomena and the lives of the most unusual animals living in the Australian wild. France

programme.title: History of Wildlife (Land of Tigers and Leopards)
programme.desc: Previously, tigers and leopards were frequent inhabitants of the Korean Peninsula. Military conflicts and technological development have greatly affected their population. How did this affect the ecological status of the region? South Korea

programme.title: t/s Wild killers (Pack tactics)

programme.title: d/f Moment (Between past and future)
programme.desc: Between the past and the future there is only a moment, a moment. How do living things adapt to time-sensitive moments? A flying squirrel skims the falling leaves, and a goshawk spends the afternoon hunting a rabbit. The rice fish jumps and grabs the flying water strider, just like in the circus. All these moments happen in the blink of an eye. We will admire how rich and intense the life of living creatures inhabiting the foggy riverbank is at this very moment. Director: Lee Young-gyu. South Korea

programme.title: BIỆT ĐỘI BÔNG HỒNG THÉP - IRON SQUAD W
programme.desc: Mùa thứ tư của chương trình sinh tồn quân sự Hàn Quốc này sẽ quyết định nữ quân nhân ưu tú nhất. Nó tập hợp sáu đơn vị Lực lượng Đặc biệt để cạnh tranh trong các nhiệm vụ đầy thử thách trên bộ, trên biển và trên không. Những nữ quân nhân dự bị hàng đầu thành lập các đội gồm bốn người để thi đấu với nhau. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ chiến đấu đến cùng trước sáu người dẫn chương trình nổi tiếng!

programme.title: ÔNG TRÙM, CẢNH SÁT VÀ TÊN XẢO QUYỆT - THE GANGSTER, THE COP, THE DEVIL
programme.desc: Phim được chuyển thể từ sự kiện có thật. Thám tử Lin thành lập một đơn vị đặc biệt để bắt giữ tên cướp xe máy và tổ chức tội phạm đứng sau vụ trộm ở Phật Sơn. Trong quá trình đó, người vợ đang mang thai của anh bị một tên cướp xe máy đâm phải, khiến anh phát hiện ra kế hoạch trả thù của chúng...

programme.title: THẠCH HẦU TRỞ VỀ - THE MONKEY IS BACK
programme.desc: Vị cứu tinh của mọi người, Stone Monkey, đã mang lại hy vọng cho một cô bé tuyệt vọng mà anh hứa sẽ nhận ra. Nhiều năm sau, Stone Monkey bị đánh bại trong trận chiến với Thần chiến tranh ba mắt, khiến hắn mất đi sức mạnh và rơi xuống phàm trần. Liệu anh ta có thể thực hiện lời hứa của mình với cô gái và ngăn chặn Thần Rừng hủy diệt trái đất?

programme.title: THỬ THÁCH TỘT ĐỘ - EXTREME ENDS
programme.desc: Extreme Ends là một chương trình thực tế phiêu lưu hành động có sự góp mặt của bốn nhân vật nổi tiếng và những vị khách đặc biệt của họ trải nghiệm sự đa dạng của Hồng Kông! Bắt đầu cuộc hành trình cùng hai nghệ sĩ Thái Lan, Gun và Ticha, khi họ khám phá cuộc sống thành phố nhộn nhịp và khám phá vùng ngoại ô thanh bình của Hồng Kông.

programme.title: CHIẾN BINH THỰC TẾ ẢO - VR FIGHTER
programme.desc: Vệ sĩ Long Wei mắc chứng rối loạn căng thẳng sau chấn thương tâm lý sau cái chết của vợ. Một ngày nọ, anh gặp Amy, người đang làm việc cho một công ty công nghệ VR và được mời dùng thử sản phẩm mới. Sau cuộc thử nghiệm, Long Wei trở thành chiến binh VR của công ty và mặc bộ áo giáp mới được phát minh. Tuy nhiên, khi những người đàn ông có vũ trang bí ẩn đột nhập, một trận chiến khốc liệt vừa mới bắt đầu...

programme.title: KỲ NGHỈ CỦA ĐẤNG MÀY RÂU - THE ULTIMATE BROCATION
programme.desc: Một chương trình thực tế vui nhộn kể về bốn nam nhân vật nổi tiếng đến từ các quốc gia khác nhau trong một kỳ nghỉ giả tưởng được đài thọ toàn bộ chi phí ở Hồng Kông, được thiết kế riêng cho các “anh em”!
